title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Triple Mango Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Triple Mango delivers a rich fusion of ripe, juicy Mango varieties for an intensely sweet tropical vape. Each puff brings smooth, sunny fruit notes with a mellow finish for a bold yet balanced flavour. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod arrives as a 2ml prefilled pod connected to a 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling or coil changes are needed—just fit to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil enhances flavour clarity and vapour performance for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
